task.description:
Review and finalize requirements PLC-01, PLC-02, PLC-03, PLC-04, SPC-01, SPC-02 (Stage 15, PENDING).

Requirements are in docs/requirements.yaml. Read the entries for each requirement ID and verify:
1. Each requirement has a complete body (title, description, acceptance criteria, MUST/SHOULD tags)
2. Acceptance criteria are testable (have clear pass/fail conditions)
3. No internal contradictions or cross-requirement conflicts
4. Cross-references to related requirements are accurate
5. If any body needs editing, make the edits in docs/requirements.yaml

Return PASS when all 6 requirements are confirmed complete and internally consistent. Return FAIL with issue list if problems are found.
